name: Siri and voice shortcuts
plain: Lets Siri send the app voice requests and read the app's shortcuts.
meaning: Siri forwards what was spoken and learned patterns; apps expose actions to the assistant.

android.permission: No runtime permission; App Actions declared in shortcuts.xml
android.api_surface: App Actions, Shortcuts, Assistant built-in intents

ios.prompt_ui: Allow or Don't Allow Siri and Dictation for the app
ios.note: App Intents shortcuts need no authorization

limits.headline: Can accept your Siri voice requests and show shortcuts, after you allow Siri
limits.user_action: You say a command to Siri, or tap Allow for Siri and Dictation
can: Run an action when you ask Siri by voice
Suggest shortcuts to you based on how you use the app
Receive the words you said to carry out the request
cannot: Hear you when you did not call Siri
Use Siri features after you tap Don't Allow
limits.differs: iPhone shows an Allow prompt for Siri and Dictation. On Android, voice requests go through the assistant with no per app prompt.

story.what_it_is: Lets Siri talk to an app, so you can use it by voice.

marketing.name: Siri and Shortcuts
marketing.pitch: Use your voice to get things done in apps, and teach Siri your routines.

marketing.name: App Actions
marketing.pitch: Let people open and use app features with Google Assistant voice commands.

story.for_you: You say 'Hey Siri, send money to Sam' or tap a suggestion on your lock screen. The phone learns your habits and offers actions at the right moment.
story.for_makers: Voice and suggestions keep an app one phrase away from the user, even when the icon is buried. Makers gain more daily opens and a way into cars, watches and speakers.

use_cases.example: 'Hey Siri, play my workout playlist' starts the right playlist in your music app.
You tell Siri to text a friend on WhatsApp and she reads your message back before sending.
A shortcut starts a ten minute stretch routine when you get to the gym.
You say 'Order my usual coffee' and the app builds the order from your last pickup.
Say 'Add milk to my list' and the item lands in the shopping app without opening it.
Lights and locks respond to a voice command from the phone, watch or car.

story.android_note: Android uses Google Assistant and App Actions, which need no extra permission prompt.
story.ios_note: iOS shows a Siri permission pop up and shares learned patterns with the app.
